children: The dollar is considered overvalued by slightly fewer investors in September, Bank of America's global fund manager survey shows. A net 37% of investors say the dollar is overvalued, compared to 39% in August. Meanwhile, a net 13% of investors think sterling is overvalued, up from 8% last month. A net 3% say the euro is undervalued, down from 5% last month. (renae.dyer@wsj.com)
